recognize_zh: A/B 圖的母細胞中等大小、細胞質少至中量淡藍色、無顆粒，染色質呈塊狀粗糙（blocky），核仁不明顯，外觀像成熟淋巴球而非典型母細胞；C 圖部分核型顯示 der(4) 與 der(12)，D 圖 ETV6 分離探針出現分開的紅綠訊號，提示 ETV6 重排。
features: Medium-sized blasts with moderate N:C ratio and pale blue agranular cytoplasm (A, B)
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with coarse, blocky clumped chromatin mimicking mature lymphocytes; nucleoli inconspicuous
Occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles; no Auer rods seen
Partial G-banded karyotype showing der(4) and der(12) of t(4;12)(q12;p13) (C)
ETV6 break-apart FISH with separated 5' and 3' signals in interphase and metaphase cells (D)
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows medium-sized blasts with pale blue agranular cytoplasm and round to slightly irregular nuclei with unusually coarse, blocky chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, imparting a pseudo-lymphoid appearance. No Auer rods are identified. Partial karyotype demonstrates der(4) and der(12) consistent with t(4;12)(q12;p13), and ETV6 break-apart FISH shows split signals indicating ETV6 rearrangement. Because morphology alone mimics a mature lymphoid neoplasm, immunophenotyping is essential; with the reported CD34+/CD13+/CD33+/CD117+ blasts, findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with ETV6 rearrangement (ETV6::CHIC2 by RNA sequencing).

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia or other mature B-cell leukemia
ddx.vs: CLL cells are small with scant cytoplasm and soccer-ball chromatin and are CD19+/CD5+/CD23+, whereas these blasts are CD34+/CD117+ myeloid by flow.
Morphology overlaps, but the blasts lack CD19/CD79a/cCD3 and express CD13, CD33 and CD117, establishing myeloid lineage.
t(4;12) with ETV6 FISH split suggested ETV6::PDGFRA, but RNA sequencing showed ETV6::CHIC2 and there is no eosinophilia.
